entities.name: Service Teams
entities.rationale: Group-of-people icon labeled 'SERVICE TEAMS' at the left of the board (partially hidden by the presenter). NAB service teams are the customers of the platform and run their pipelines in the non-production account.

entities.name: ECS (Kong)
entities.rationale: Orange ECS icon labeled 'ECS'. Per transcript it runs Kong, which publishes the API endpoints that receive build events from the teams' pipelines. Not drawn inside any box.

entities.name: Lambda (x25)
entities.rationale: Orange Lambda icon labeled 'LAMBDA' with a stacked outline and the annotation 'x25', indicating about 25 functions. Captures events, stores them and executes the compliance assessment.

entities.name: RDS PostgreSQL
entities.rationale: Blue RDS icon labeled 'RDS POSTGRESQL' at the top right. Holds the relational compliance framework (standards, controls, teams and services).

entities.name: DynamoDB
entities.rationale: Blue DynamoDB icon labeled 'DYNAMODB' at the right, below RDS. Stores the build events and evidence from the teams' pipelines as key-value data.

entities.name: SNS
entities.rationale: Pink SNS icon labeled 'SNS' at the bottom right. Used to securely notify and fan out promotion events to the production accounts.

entities.name: NON-PROD account
entities.rationale: Blue dashed box labeled 'NON-PROD' at the bottom left. Represents the service teams' non-production AWS account where their pipelines run. No icons are drawn inside the box.

entities.name: PROD account
entities.rationale: Blue dashed box labeled 'PROD' at the bottom centre. Represents the service teams' production AWS account that receives promoted artifacts and deployment notifications. No icons are drawn inside the box.

visual_connections.description: Curved white arrow from the top of the NON-PROD box up to the ECS icon: pipelines in the non-production account send build events and API calls to Kong on ECS.
Straight white arrow from ECS to Lambda: Kong forwards the requests to the Lambda functions.
Curved white arrow from the bottom of the NON-PROD box to the PROD box: artifacts are promoted/copied from non-production to production.
